name: H3 - Detection/First-Strike Advantage: Recon vs Infantry with Equalized Combat Stats
hypothesis: H3: A unit with superior detection range gains a decisive first-strike advantage — it sees, engages, and damages the enemy before being detected in return.
description: Two ReconSquads vs two InfantrySquads on an open field. Both teams have identical combat stats (HP, firepower, armor, accuracy) equalized to remove unit quality as a variable. Only detection range (12 vs 6) and mobility (3 vs 2) differ. Each team starts grouped in its spawn zone.
expected_observations: Blue (Recon) should win >70% of engagements due to 12 observation_range vs 6 and 3 mobility vs 2, giving them both detection and positioning advantage.
